items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: I ain't seen them boys in a long time. Pokechop and Kidney Stood that left with?

ctx.x: That's not the same Pokechop as a dancing today, huh? I don't know if Pokechop and Yeah Man could be.

I ain't seen them boys in a long time. Pokechop and Kidney Stood that left with? No, that was at Luchin Till. That was at Luchin Till. Yeah. Well, we had a Pokechop out there, but he was cool. He could get a good age already now, I imagine. Of course, I'm a Pokechop.
Who was shot you talking about? The King?
